title: China to Convene Meeting on Supporting Stock Market, Reports Say
summary: China’s central bank and its securities regulator will hold a meeting on Monday to discuss the use of tools designed to support the country’s capital market, according to local media.

summary: Philippine bonds may become one of Asia’s best performers once inflation pressures ease and risks from the Iran war recede, according to Brandywine Global Investment Management.

title: Learjet Plummets to Ground in Florida Neighborhood

title: Colombia at Risk of Default Without a Fix, Restrepo Tells Semana
summary: Colombia is at risk of default if Congress fails to approve a fiscal adjustment bill, Vice President José Manuel Restrepo said in an interview with local magazine Semana, warning that the country faces a severe economic crisis without the proposed measures.

title: Westpac CEO’s Pay Surges, Profit Misses Analyst Estimates

title: Trump Struggles to Sell Voters on the Economy
summary: Bloomberg News Senior Executive Editor Wes Kosova tells Bloomberg This Weekend that President Donald Trump is struggling to convince voters the economy is strong as higher fuel prices and affordability concerns weigh on his support, including among Republicans. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Lisa Mateo, Kosova says Trump’s last-minute promises of financial relief may have limited power to change voters’ perceptions, while the prolonged Iran war adds uncertainty over when energy prices could ease. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Pakistan LNG Cargo Attacked Near Hormuz Had Iranian Approval
